import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Load all necessary data files
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract species order from submission template
species_order = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col != "id"]
species_map = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(species_order)}

# Map training species to aligned integer labels
train_species = train.copy()
train_species["species_code"] = train_species["species"].map(lambda x: species_map[x])
train_labels = train_species["species_code"]

# Prepare features excluding id/species/columns
feature_cols = [
    col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "species", "species_code"]
]
X_train_full = train[feature_cols]
X_test = test.drop("id", axis=1)

# Create proper train/test split WITHOUT refitting on full data
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, train_labels, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_labels
)

# Train model on training subset only
model = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Calculate genuine hold-out validation logloss
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)
validation_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {validation_score:.6f}")

# Generate final test predictions
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Build submission with correct column order
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"]})
for idx, species in enumerate(species_order):
    submission[species] = test_preds[:, idx]

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
